study_type_evidence.quote: We carried out in vivo PK studies in huFcRn transgenic mice with the top selective mutant, 1F7
study_type_evidence.section: RESULTS / Retention of HER4 selectivity and increased serum half-life by ALM

study_type_evidence.quote: Fusion protein or antibody variants were transiently transfected into the human embryonic kidney cell line HEK293FT
study_type_evidence.section: METHODS / Neuregulin-MFC fusion proteins and ALM expression and purification

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: huFcRn (hFcRn) transgenic mice; strain designation, sex and age not reported
in_vivo_species.quote: hFcRn transgenic mice serum clearance curves are plotted for parental NRG1-MFc (black), 1F7-MFc (blue), parental antibody ligand mimetic ALM6 (red), and ALM6-1F7 (green)

in_vitro_detail: HEK293/HEK293FT transient expression of ALM and MFc-fusion constructs; biolayer interferometry (Octet) binding to biotinylated recombinant HER4 and HER3 ECD on streptavidin biosensors; SEC-MALS homogeneity analysis; HER2/HER4 and HER2/HER3 dual-expressing HEK293 SRE-luciferase reporter gene assays; no-wash Mirrorball cell-surface binding assays and flow cytometry on HER3- or HER4-expressing HEK293 lines; phospho-AKT activation in iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes; saturation scanning and combinatorial mutagenesis library screening by ELISA.

concentration_time_figure.locator: Fig. 6A (with Fig. 6B as a second detection-method panel)
concentration_time_figure.caption_quote: In vivo PK profiles of neuregulin fusion proteins. (A) hFcRn transgenic mice serum clearance curves are plotted for parental NRG1-MFc (black), 1F7-MFc (blue), parental antibody ligand mimetic ALM6 (red), and ALM6-1F7 (green)
concentration_time_figure.note: Fig. 6A plots serum concentration versus time (serum clearance curves) in huFcRn transgenic mice for all four dosed constructs plus a peptide control. bioanalytical_method: Quantitative sandwich ELISA (goat anti-mouse IgG1-Fc capture, mouse anti-NRG1 detection antibody, goat anti-human Fc-specific HRP conjugate, TMB substrate, A450), with parallel Fc-domain and C-kappa light-chain detection formats; non-compartmental PK analysis in Phoenix 64 WinNonlin 8.1
bioanalytical_quote: A quantitative ELISA was used to monitor the serum concentrations of the tested antibodies. ... Non-compartmental PK data analysis was performed using Phoenix 64 WinNonlin 8.1
notes: Half-lives (1.4 h for NRG1-MFc and ALM6; 6.6 h for 1F7-MFc and ALM6-1F7) come from Table 3, which is explicitly titled 'In vivo mouse PK analysis of MFc fusion proteins and ALMs' - this contradicts the PeplLife2 metadata, which labels all four rows 'In Vitro'. The body describes these as in vivo PK studies in huFcRn transgenic mice, not a serum stability assay. Route of administration and number of animals per group are never stated anywhere in the body or Methods; only the 5 mg/kg dose from Table 3 is given. The Methods 'In vivo PK assays' section describes only the ELISA and the non-compartmental analysis, with no animal husbandry, ethics statement, strain designation, sex, age, or group size. No amino acid sequences are printed in the body other than the 15-residue fragment NEFTGDRGQNYVMAS; the full NRG1 EGF-domain and Fc sequences listed in the PeplLife2 metadata do not appear in the body. Table 3 also reports AUCINF and clearance: NRG1-MFc 17 h*ug/mL and 288 mL/h/kg; 1F7-MFc 17 and 292; ALM6 26 and 194; ALM6-1F7 91 and 55. Tmax is not reported for any agent.
